_meta.note: KAS 0.66.70 (the @kiro/agent package.json kiro-cli 2.35.1 installs) reached through `kiro-cli acp --agent-engine v3 --auth-method cli`, the production relay spawn, driven over stdio by a scratch client. Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, except: the session id, the tool-call id and every engine-minted uuid are replaced with fixed synthetic values at capture, and the scratch work dir reads as /work. The client's initialize carried `_meta.kiro.settings.toolSearch={enabled:false, neverDefer:["probe::probe_codeword"]}`; the probe-agent spec (one MCP server `probe`, one tool `probe_codeword`) was projected through `_meta.kiro.customAgents` on session/new with an EMPTY session/new mcpServers array, then activated with session/set_mode `probe-agent`. Asked for the codeword, the model's `probe_codeword` tool_call carries `_meta.kiro.toolOrigin: "client"` -- KAS made that MCP tool DIRECT because the client's settings.toolSearch.neverDefer named it, rather than deferring it by its own default; a control run with an empty settings object showed the same tool with toolOrigin `default`. The call completed with `tangerine-42`, so the spec's own server reached the session off the wire array. Host-inventory and bookkeeping frames are omitted (_kiro/* notifications, every session_info_update, and the in_progress tool_call_update), as is the session/new response's agent and entitlement list (kept TRIMMED to sessionId and modes.currentModeId). The initialize response is kept: no agentInfo, and its agentCapabilities._meta.kiro.extensionMethods marks it KAS, not kiro-cli.
